_note: letter-salutation-and-appointment. The line that opens a letter to a person, as they asked for it, such as "Geachte mevrouw De Vries". A letter template prints it as client.salutation or contact.salutation. Nothing derives it from a name, a gender or an address: a salutation is something a person states, and unset means unset, so a preview shows the field as not filled in rather than guessing.

salutation.title: Salutation
salutation.description: How this person asked to be addressed at the top of a letter, such as Geachte mevrouw De Vries.
